title: Homecoming and Recipe
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Oscar Vane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
